findings.detail: Private-credit rows have blank interest_rate even though the source schedule contains populated Reference Rate and Spread cells.

rationale: Class 1 repeated single-cell defect. The extracted holdings show blank interest_rate values, but the filing schedule explicitly reports rate/spread terms for matching positions. Representative current-period source rows show S + 4.75% for AA&D Midco, S + 5.38% including 2.88% PIK for Titan BW, and S + 7.00% including 5.00% PIK for SEKO. The X02 flags therefore identify a real systematic extraction gap in the rate column.
